name: factory v2 as run in loop 0, plus --effort low, in single-shot metered form

S.what: one worker call writes CONTRACT.md and tests.json (template, rubric fields, >= 4 tests incl. boundary, assumption pin, trap); the coordinator freezes both by hash before compiling

G.what: the same call writes kernel.ts and glue.json after the tests (shared context, as in loop 0); up to 3 repair rounds on gate feedback, kernel.ts and glue.json only

Q.what: G1-G7 from campaigns/x1-spec-study/factory/gate.mjs, byte-identical to loop 0 (sha256 in freeze.json)

R.what: blind output persona stage: one call, two personas chosen from the requester role, on the consumer sheet (frozen-test calls + coordinator probe calls); reject -> not promoted; accept-with-change -> promoted-pending-change

promotion: promoted = gated (G1-G7 re-run by the coordinator) and no persona reject; pending-change counts as promoted (shipped) as in loop 0
departuresFromLoop0: single-shot CLI call instead of a multi-turn Agent-tool worker with the kit (the coordinator runs freeze and gates; the worker has no tools): required for per-stage token metering and the 8M budget; the information flow (one context writes tests then kernel) is unchanged
model: claude-opus-5-5 through claude -p (the CLI default) at --effort low; loop 0's workers ran on the orchestrating session's model through the Agent tool
persona stage in single-shot form on a rendered sheet (the loop-0 persona agent ran try.mjs itself); personas chosen by a fixed mapping from the requester role

inc-default.note: the incumbent without its low-effort move (noise-floor third arm)
